title: perf(canary): improved regression detector + hysteresis rollout guards
author: Priya Nair
description:
Context: our continuous performance canary has produced a number of false positives during bursty traffic windows and model seeding periods. This PR improves the automated detector sensitivity and adds hysteresis-based rollout guards so short-lived fluctuations do not trigger canary rollbacks or block rollouts.

Summary of changes: 1) Detector: add adaptive baseline smoothing (EWMA with window tuned per-route) and distribution-aware thresholds (p90/p99). 2) Hysteresis guard: require sustained threshold breach for configurable duration + rate-limited state transitions to avoid flip-flopping. 3) Canary policy: add 'grace_period' and 'min_sample_rate' checks before enforcement. 4) Observability: new metrics (canary.detector.consec_violations, canary.hysteresis_state) and alert labels. 5) Tests & CI: new unit and synthetic load tests, perf CI that replays historical traces.

Motivation: reduce noisy rollbacks and unhelpful alerts while keeping detection sensitivity for real regressions. This change was driven by multiple incidents where short-lived infra noise tripped rollouts (see SUP-3421).

Checklist:
- [x] Detector algorithm implemented and covered by unit tests
- [x] Hysteresis state machine + configurable parameters
- [x] Integration test replays (historical trace set)
- [x] Metrics & dashboards updated
- [x] Backwards-compatible config with defaults to preserve current behavior

Testing notes: unit tests cover edge cases (low-sample routes, high-variance routes). Integration job replays 7 days of production traces; synthetic loads validate hysteresis prevents rollbacks for spikes shorter than configured window.

Rollout plan: merge to main -> staged rollout to perf-canary service in staging -> 48h smoke with synthetic anomalies -> enable in canary for low-traffic routes (10% sample) for 72h -> ramp to 100% if no regressions. Rollback: feature flag to revert to previous detector and immediate disable of hysteresis gating.

Related: earlier perf canary PRs and detector tuning work (see ENG-2415, ENG-2502).
